source.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אֹ֜רֶךְ וְחָמֵ֧שׁ אַמּ֣וֹת רֹ֗חַב רָב֤וּעַ יִהְיֶה֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make the altar [of] woods of acacia, five cubits length and five cubits breadth; square will be the altar, and three cubits its height.

en.L: And you shall make the altar [of] acacia wood, 5 cubits [in] length and 5 cubits [in] breadth; square the altar shall be, and 3 cubits its height.
en.B: Make the altar out of acacia wood. It is to be square, {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} on each side and {{units:about 4 1/2 feet|3 cubits}} high.
en.R: Build an altar for burnt offerings out of acacia wood. Make it square, {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} on each side and {{units:about 4 1/2 feet|3 cubits}} tall.

es.L: Y harás el altar [de] madera de acacia, cinco codos [de] longitud y cinco codos [de] anchura; cuadrado será el altar, y tres codos su altura.
es.B: Harás el altar de madera de acacia. Será cuadrado, de {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} por lado y {{units:unos 1,35 metros|tres codos}} de alto.
es.R: Construye un altar para los holocaustos con madera de acacia. Hazlo cuadrado, de {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} por cada lado y {{units:unos 1,35 metros|tres codos}} de alto.

fr.L: Et tu feras l’autel [en] bois d’acacia, cinq coudées [de] longueur et cinq coudées [de] largeur ; carré sera l’autel, et trois coudées sa hauteur.
fr.B: Tu feras l’autel en bois d’acacia. Il sera carré, de {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de côté et de {{units:environ 1,35 mètre|trois coudées}} de haut.
fr.R: Construis un autel pour les holocaustes avec du bois d’acacia. Fais-le carré, de {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de chaque côté et de {{units:environ 1,35 mètre|trois coudées}} de haut.

sw.L: Nawe utaifanya madhabahu [kwa] mbao za mshita, dhiraa tano urefu na dhiraa tano upana; madhabahu itakuwa ya mraba, na dhiraa tatu kimo chake.
sw.B: Uifanye madhabahu kwa mbao za mshita. Iwe ya mraba, {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}} kila upande, na kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 1.35|dhiraa tatu}}.
sw.R: Jenga madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa mbao za mshita. Ifanye iwe ya mraba, {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}} kila upande, na kimo chake {{units:karibu mita 1.35|dhiraa tatu}}.

decisions.choice: the altar: the bronze altar of burnt offering in the courtyard
decisions.reason: "The altar" is the altar for the daily burnt offerings (29:38-42), set in the courtyard before the entrance of the tabernacle (40:6, 29). It is later called the altar of burnt offering (30:28; 38:1) and the bronze altar (38:30), to tell it apart from the gold altar of incense inside (30:1-6).

decisions.choice: cubit: a measure of length, from the elbow to the tip of the fingers, about 18 inches
decisions.reason: The cubit was the common measure of length, the length of a forearm, about 18 inches (about 45 centimeters). The altar was about 7 1/2 feet square and about 4 1/2 feet high.

decisions.choice: modern measure first, cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the altar's size in feet by default, with the cubits of the Hebrew as the units alternative (a cubit is about 18 inches; see the note at verse 1). Literal keeps cubits.

decisions.choice: an altar for burnt offerings
decisions.reason: Readable says what the altar is for, since this is the first time it is described (see 29:38-42; 38:1). Literal and Balanced keep "the altar".

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ קַרְנֹתָ֗יו עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנֹּתָ֔יו מִמֶּ֖נּוּ תִּהְיֶ֣יןָ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make its horns on its four corners; from it will be its horns, and you will overlay it [with] bronze.

en.L: And you shall make its horns on its four corners; its horns shall be from it, and you shall overlay it [with] bronze.
en.B: Shape horns on its four corners, forming part of the altar itself, and overlay it all with bronze.
en.R: Make a horn-shaped point that sticks up at each of its four corners. These horns must be part of the altar itself, not separate pieces. Cover the whole altar with bronze.

es.L: Y harás sus cuernos sobre sus cuatro esquinas; de él [mismo] serán sus cuernos, y lo revestirás [de] bronce.
es.B: Le harás cuernos en sus cuatro esquinas, que formen parte del altar mismo, y lo revestirás todo de bronce.
es.R: En cada una de sus cuatro esquinas haz una punta en forma de cuerno que sobresalga hacia arriba. Estos cuernos deben ser parte del mismo altar, no piezas sueltas. Cubre todo el altar de bronce.

fr.L: Et tu feras ses cornes sur ses quatre angles ; ses cornes seront [tirées] de lui, et tu le plaqueras [de] bronze.
fr.B: Tu façonneras des cornes à ses quatre angles, faisant corps avec l’autel, et tu le plaqueras entièrement de bronze.
fr.R: À chacun des quatre coins, fais une pointe en forme de corne, dressée vers le haut. Ces cornes doivent faire partie de l’autel lui-même, et non être des pièces rapportées. Recouvre tout l’autel de bronze.

sw.L: Nawe utazifanya pembe zake juu ya kona zake nne; pembe zake zitakuwa za kipande kimoja nayo, nawe utaifunika [kwa] shaba.
sw.B: Uitengenezee pembe kwenye kona zake nne, ziwe sehemu ya madhabahu yenyewe, na uifunike yote kwa shaba.
sw.R: Kwenye kila moja ya kona zake nne tengeneza ncha yenye umbo la pembe inayochomoza juu. Pembe hizo lazima ziwe sehemu ya madhabahu yenyewe, si vipande vilivyoungwa baadaye. Funika madhabahu yote kwa shaba.

decisions.choice: horns: points rising at the corners of the altar, shaped like horns
decisions.reason: The horns stood up from the four corners of the altar. The blood of the sin offering was put on them (29:12; Leviticus 4:7), and a person in danger might take hold of them to seek protection (1 Kings 1:50; 2:28).

decisions.choice: its horns shall be from it: of one piece with the altar
decisions.reason: The horns were not to be made separately and fixed on; they were part of the altar's own structure, as the lampstand's cups and branches are "from it" (25:31, 36).

decisions.choice: bronze: copper or a copper alloy
decisions.reason: The word covers copper and its alloys. Bronze marks the courtyard and its altar, while gold is used for the furnishings inside the tabernacle (25:11-39).

decisions.choice: a horn-shaped point that sticks up
decisions.reason: Readable describes the horns, which a reader may not picture, and spells out "from it" as "part of the altar itself".

decisions.choice: "pembe" (horns); "kona" (corners)
decisions.reason: Swahili "pembe" means both a horn and a corner, so the corners of the altar are "kona" here, leaving "pembe" for the horns that rise from them.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ סִּֽירֹתָיו֙ לְדַשְּׁנ֔וֹ וְיָעָיו֙ וּמִזְרְקֹתָ֔יו וּמִזְלְגֹתָ֖יו וּמַחְתֹּתָ֑יו לְכָל־כֵּלָ֖יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make its pots to take away its fatty ashes, and its shovels and its bowls and its forks and its firepans; for all its articles you will make [of] bronze.

en.L: And you shall make its pots for removing its fatty ashes, and its shovels and its basins and its forks and its firepans; all its utensils you shall make [of] bronze.
en.B: Make its pots for clearing away the fat-soaked ashes, along with its shovels, basins, forks and firepans. All of its utensils are to be made of bronze.
en.R: Make pots to carry away the greasy ashes. Also make shovels, bowls, forks, and pans for carrying hot coals. Make all these tools out of bronze.

es.L: Y harás sus ollas para quitar sus cenizas grasientas, y sus palas, y sus cuencos, y sus tenedores, y sus braseros; todos sus utensilios los harás [de] bronce.
es.B: Harás sus ollas para retirar las cenizas empapadas de grasa, y también sus palas, cuencos, tenedores y braseros. Todos sus utensilios serán de bronce.
es.R: Haz ollas para llevarse las cenizas grasientas. Haz también palas, cuencos, tenedores y recipientes para llevar las brasas. Haz todas estas herramientas de bronce.

fr.L: Et tu feras ses pots pour en ôter les cendres grasses, et ses pelles, et ses bassins, et ses fourchettes, et ses récipients à braises ; tous ses ustensiles, tu les feras [en] bronze.
fr.B: Tu feras ses pots pour enlever les cendres imprégnées de graisse, ainsi que ses pelles, ses bassins, ses fourchettes et ses récipients à braises. Tous ses ustensiles seront en bronze.
fr.R: Fais des pots pour emporter les cendres grasses. Fais aussi des pelles, des bols, des fourchettes et des récipients pour transporter les braises. Fais tous ces outils en bronze.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya vyungu vyake vya kuondolea majivu yake yenye mafuta, na sepetu zake, na mabakuli yake, na nyuma zake, na vyetezo vyake; vyombo vyake vyote utavifanya [kwa] shaba.
sw.B: Uifanyie vyungu vya kuondolea majivu yaliyolowa mafuta, pamoja na sepetu, mabakuli, nyuma na vyetezo vyake. Vyombo vyake vyote viwe vya shaba.
sw.R: Tengeneza vyungu vya kubebea majivu yenye mafuta. Tengeneza pia sepetu, mabakuli, nyuma za kushikia nyama, na vyombo vya kubebea makaa ya moto. Tengeneza vifaa hivi vyote kwa shaba.

decisions.choice: removing its fatty ashes: clearing out the ashes soaked with the fat of the offerings
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the word for ashes mixed with fat from the burnt offerings. These were carried out to a clean place (Leviticus 1:16; 4:12).

decisions.choice: basins: bowls for the blood of the offerings
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning to throw or splash. These bowls held the blood of the sacrifices, which was splashed against the altar (24:6; 29:16).

decisions.choice: forks ... firepans: forks for the meat, and pans for carrying burning coals
decisions.reason: Forks were used to handle the meat of the sacrifices (1 Samuel 2:13-14). The firepans carried burning coals; the same word is used for the pans in which incense was burned (Leviticus 10:1; 16:12).

decisions.choice: greasy ashes ... pans for carrying hot coals
decisions.reason: Readable describes the ashes and says what the firepans were for. Literal and Balanced keep "fatty ashes" or "fat-soaked ashes" and "firepans".

decisions.choice: "nyuma" (forks, pl. of "uma"); "vyetezo" (firepans)
decisions.reason: "Nyuma" is the plural of "uma" (fork); Readable adds "za kushikia nyama" so it is not read as "behind". "Vyetezo" follows the firepans of 25:38; Readable says what they carried.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ לּוֹ֙ מִכְבָּ֔ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֶ֣שֶׁת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עַל־הָרֶ֗שֶׁת אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֥ע קְצוֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make for it a grating, a work of a net [of] bronze, and you will make on the net four rings [of] bronze on its four ends.

en.L: And you shall make for it a grating, a work of network [of] bronze, and you shall make on the network four rings [of] bronze at its four ends.
en.B: Make for it a grating of bronze, worked as a mesh, and attach four bronze rings to the mesh at its four corners.
en.R: Make a bronze grate shaped like a net for the altar. Put four bronze rings on its four corners.

es.L: Y le harás un enrejado, obra de red [de] bronce, y harás sobre la red cuatro anillos [de] bronce en sus cuatro extremos.
es.B: Le harás un enrejado de bronce en forma de malla, y fijarás a la malla cuatro anillos de bronce en sus cuatro esquinas.
es.R: Haz para el altar una parrilla de bronce en forma de red. Pon cuatro anillos de bronce en sus cuatro esquinas.

fr.L: Et tu lui feras une grille, ouvrage en treillis [de] bronze, et tu feras sur le treillis quatre anneaux [de] bronze à ses quatre extrémités.
fr.B: Tu lui feras une grille de bronze travaillée en treillis, et tu fixeras au treillis quatre anneaux de bronze, à ses quatre coins.
fr.R: Fais pour l’autel une grille de bronze en forme de filet. Mets quatre anneaux de bronze à ses quatre coins.

sw.L: Nawe utaifanyia wavu, kazi ya kusuka [ya] shaba, nawe utafanya juu ya wavu huo pete nne [za] shaba kwenye ncha zake nne.
sw.B: Uifanyie wavu wa shaba uliosukwa kama nyavu, na ufunge pete nne za shaba kwenye kona nne za wavu huo.
sw.R: Tengeneza wavu wa shaba kwa ajili ya madhabahu. Weka pete nne za shaba kwenye kona zake nne.

decisions.choice: a grating, a work of network: a lattice of bronze, placed on the lower half of the altar
alternatives: a grate inside the altar, to hold the fire
decisions.reason: The grating was a bronze lattice set under the ledge and reaching halfway up the altar (verse 5). The text does not say whether it was inside, holding the fire, or outside, around the lower part of the frame. Rings for the poles at its corners (verse 7) suggest it was on the outside.

decisions.choice: its four ends: the four corners of the grating
decisions.reason: The rings were at the corners so that poles could be passed through them to carry the altar (verse 7).

decisions.choice: "enrejado" (L, B), "parrilla" (R); "red" (L), "malla" (B)
decisions.reason: An "enrejado" is a lattice of crossed bars; Readable says "parrilla", the everyday word for a metal grate. The "work of a net" is "obra de red" at Literal and a "malla" (mesh) at Balanced.

decisions.choice: "grille"; "treillis" (L, B), "en forme de filet" (R)
decisions.reason: "Grille" is a lattice of metal bars; "treillis" is the crossed work it is made of. Readable says it looks like a net.

source.text: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗הּ תַּ֛חַת כַּרְכֹּ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ מִלְּמָ֑טָּה וְהָיְתָ֣ה הָרֶ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ד חֲצִ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put it under the ledge of the altar from below, and will be the net up to [the] middle of the altar.

en.L: And you shall put it under the ledge of the altar, below, and the network shall be [reaching] to the middle of the altar.
en.B: Place the grating beneath the ledge of the altar, down below, so that the mesh reaches to the middle of the altar.
en.R: Fit the grate under the ledge that runs around the altar, so that it comes up to the middle of the altar.

es.L: Y lo pondrás debajo del reborde del altar, abajo, y la red [llegará] hasta la mitad del altar.
es.B: Colocarás el enrejado debajo del reborde del altar, en la parte de abajo, de modo que la malla llegue hasta la mitad del altar.
es.R: Coloca la parrilla debajo del reborde que rodea el altar, de modo que llegue hasta la mitad de la altura del altar.

fr.L: Et tu la mettras sous le rebord de l’autel, en bas, et le treillis [ira] jusqu’au milieu de l’autel.
fr.B: Tu placeras la grille sous le rebord de l’autel, vers le bas, de sorte que le treillis arrive à mi-hauteur de l’autel.
fr.R: Place la grille sous le rebord qui fait le tour de l’autel, pour qu’elle monte jusqu’à la moitié de sa hauteur.

sw.L: Nawe utauweka chini ya ukingo wa madhabahu, upande wa chini, na wavu huo [utafika] hadi katikati ya madhabahu.
sw.B: Uweke wavu huo chini ya ukingo wa madhabahu, upande wa chini, ili wavu ufike nusu ya kimo cha madhabahu.
sw.R: Weka wavu chini ya ukingo unaozunguka madhabahu, ili ufike hadi nusu ya kimo chake.

decisions.choice: the ledge: a rim or border around the altar, halfway up
decisions.reason: The word is found only here and in 38:4, and its meaning is not certain. It seems to have been a ledge or band around the sides of the altar, at about half its height, with the grating below it.

decisions.choice: to the middle of the altar: halfway up its height
decisions.reason: The grating rose from the bottom of the altar to its middle, about 1 1/2 cubits up.

decisions.choice: the ledge that runs around the altar
decisions.reason: Readable describes the ledge as going around the altar, the likely sense of an uncertain word (see the footnote).

decisions.choice: "reborde" (karkov)
decisions.reason: The word is rare and its sense uncertain (see the note); "reborde", a projecting edge, fits the likely sense of a ledge around the altar without saying more than the text.

decisions.choice: "rebord" (karkov)
decisions.reason: The word is rare and its sense uncertain (see the note); "rebord", a projecting edge, fits the likely sense of a ledge around the altar.

decisions.choice: "ukingo" (karkov)
decisions.reason: The word is rare and its sense uncertain (see the note); "ukingo", a raised edge or border, fits the likely sense of a ledge around the altar. It is the same word as the gold molding of 25:11, a different object.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ בַדִּים֙ לַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בַּדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make poles for the altar, poles of woods of acacia, and you will overlay them [with] bronze.

en.L: And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and you shall overlay them [with] bronze.
en.B: The altar is also to have poles: make them of acacia wood and overlay them with bronze.
en.R: Make poles out of acacia wood for carrying the altar, and cover them with bronze.

es.L: Y harás barras para el altar, barras de madera de acacia, y las revestirás [de] bronce.
es.B: El altar tendrá también barras: las harás de madera de acacia y las revestirás de bronce.
es.R: Haz barras de madera de acacia para llevar el altar, y cúbrelas de bronce.

fr.L: Et tu feras des barres pour l’autel, des barres de bois d’acacia, et tu les plaqueras [de] bronze.
fr.B: L’autel aura aussi des barres : tu les feras en bois d’acacia et tu les plaqueras de bronze.
fr.R: Fais des barres en bois d’acacia pour porter l’autel, et recouvre-les de bronze.

sw.L: Nawe utaifanyia madhabahu mipiko, mipiko ya mbao za mshita, nawe utaifunika [kwa] shaba.
sw.B: Madhabahu iwe pia na mipiko: uifanye kwa mbao za mshita na uifunike kwa shaba.
sw.R: Tengeneza mipiko ya mbao za mshita ya kubebea madhabahu, na uifunike kwa shaba.

decisions.choice: poles: carrying poles
decisions.reason: Like the ark and the table (25:13-15, 27-28), the altar was carried on poles when Israel moved camp (Numbers 4:13-14).

decisions.choice: for carrying the altar
decisions.reason: Readable says what the poles were for, as verse 7 makes clear.

source.text: וְהוּבָ֥א אֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו בַּטַּבָּעֹ֑ת וְהָי֣וּ הַבַּדִּ֗ים עַל־שְׁתֵּ֛י צַלְעֹ֥ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בִּשְׂאֵ֥ת אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be put its poles into the rings, and will be the poles on [the] two sides of the altar in carrying it.

en.L: And its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar in carrying it.
en.B: The poles are to be slid through the rings, so that they run along both sides of the altar whenever it is carried.
en.R: Slide the poles through the rings. The poles will be on both sides of the altar, so people can carry it.

es.L: Y se meterán sus barras en los anillos, y estarán las barras a los dos costados del altar al llevarlo.
es.B: Las barras se pasarán por los anillos, de modo que queden a lo largo de ambos costados del altar cada vez que se transporte.
es.R: Mete las barras por los anillos. Las barras quedarán a los dos lados del altar, para que la gente pueda llevarlo.

fr.L: Et ses barres seront introduites dans les anneaux, et les barres seront sur les deux côtés de l’autel quand on le portera.
fr.B: On passera les barres dans les anneaux, de sorte qu’elles longent les deux côtés de l’autel chaque fois qu’on le transportera.
fr.R: Glisse les barres dans les anneaux. Elles seront des deux côtés de l’autel, et on pourra ainsi le porter.

sw.L: Na mipiko yake itatiwa ndani ya pete, nayo mipiko itakuwa pande mbili za madhabahu wakati wa kuibeba.
sw.B: Mipiko ipitishwe ndani ya pete, ili iwe pande zote mbili za madhabahu kila inapobebwa.
sw.R: Pitisha mipiko ndani ya pete. Mipiko itakuwa pande zote mbili za madhabahu, ili watu waweze kuibeba.

decisions.choice: the rings: the four rings at the corners of the grating
decisions.reason: These are the rings of verse 4. Two poles passed through them, one along each side of the altar.

decisions.choice: in carrying it: whenever the altar is moved
decisions.reason: The poles were for carrying the altar when the camp moved on (Numbers 4:13-15).

source.text: נְב֥וּב לֻחֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶרְאָ֥ה אֹתְךָ֛ בָּהָ֖ר כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Hollow of boards you will make it; just as he showed you on the mountain, so they will make [it].

en.L: Hollow, [of] boards you shall make it; just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} showed you on the mountain, so they shall make [it].
en.B: The altar is to be a hollow box built of planks. Let them make it according to what you were shown on the mountain.
en.R: Make the altar like a hollow box out of boards. The workers must build it exactly the way you were shown on the mountain.

es.L: Hueco, [de] tablas lo harás; como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te mostró en el monte, así [lo] harán.
es.B: El altar será una caja hueca hecha de tablas. Que lo hagan según lo que se te mostró en el monte.
es.R: Haz el altar como una caja hueca de tablas. Los trabajadores deben construirlo exactamente como se te mostró en el monte.

fr.L: Creux, [en] planches, tu le feras ; comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te [l’]a montré sur la montagne, ainsi on [le] fera.
fr.B: L’autel sera une caisse creuse faite de planches. Qu’on le fasse d’après ce qui t’a été montré sur la montagne.
fr.R: Fais l’autel comme une caisse creuse en planches. Les ouvriers doivent le construire exactement comme on te l’a montré sur la montagne.

sw.L: Yenye uvungu, [ya] mbao utaifanya; kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alivyokuonyesha mlimani, ndivyo watakavyoifanya.
sw.B: Madhabahu iwe sanduku lenye uvungu lililotengenezwa kwa mbao. Waifanye kulingana na ulivyoonyeshwa mlimani.
sw.R: Tengeneza madhabahu kama sanduku lililo tupu ndani, kwa mbao. Mafundi lazima waijenge sawasawa kabisa na ulivyoonyeshwa mlimani.

decisions.choice: hollow, of boards: a hollow frame of planks
decisions.reason: The altar was a box of acacia planks covered with bronze, with no top or bottom. It may have been filled with earth or stones where it stood, as the earlier law of the altar asks for an altar of earth or uncut stones (20:24-25), but the text does not say so.

decisions.choice: as he showed you: as you were shown, by God
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject and may be impersonal ("as it was shown you"). God is the one who showed Moses the pattern on the mountain (25:9, 40; 26:30).

decisions.choice: you were shown
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the passive, as in 25:40 and 26:30. Readable names the workers as "they". Literal keeps "he showed you".

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֖ת חֲצַ֣ר הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן לִפְאַ֣ת נֶֽגֶב־תֵּ֠ימָנָה קְלָעִ֨ים לֶחָצֵ֜ר שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר מֵאָ֤ה בָֽאַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ לַפֵּאָ֖ה הָאֶחָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make the courtyard of the tabernacle; for the side of the south, southward, hangings for the courtyard [of] fine linen twisted, one hundred by the cubit [the] length for the one side.

en.L: And you shall make the courtyard of the tabernacle. For the south side, southward, [there shall be] hangings for the courtyard [of] fine twisted linen, 100 cubits [the] length for the one side.
en.B: You are also to make the courtyard of the tabernacle. On the south side the courtyard is to have hangings of fine twisted linen, {{units:about 150 feet|100 cubits}} long on that one side.
en.R: Make a courtyard around the tabernacle. Along the south side, put up hangings made of fine twisted linen. That side is to be {{units:about 150 feet|100 cubits}} long.

es.L: Y harás el atrio del tabernáculo. Para el lado del Néguev, hacia el sur, [habrá] colgaduras para el atrio [de] lino fino torcido, cien codos [de] longitud para un lado.
es.B: Harás también el atrio del tabernáculo. En el lado sur, el atrio tendrá colgaduras de lino fino torcido, de {{units:unos 45 metros|cien codos}} de largo en ese lado.
es.R: Haz un atrio alrededor del tabernáculo. A lo largo del lado sur, pon colgaduras de lino fino torcido. Ese lado debe medir {{units:unos 45 metros|cien codos}} de largo.

fr.L: Et tu feras le parvis de la Demeure. Du côté du Néguev, vers le sud, [il y aura] des toiles pour le parvis [en] fin lin retors, cent coudées [de] longueur pour un côté.
fr.B: Tu feras aussi le parvis de la Demeure. Du côté sud, le parvis aura des toiles de fin lin retors, sur {{units:environ 45 mètres|cent coudées}} de long pour ce côté-là.
fr.R: Fais une cour tout autour du tabernacle. Le long du côté sud, dresse des toiles en fin lin retors. Ce côté doit mesurer {{units:environ 45 mètres|cent coudées}} de long.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya ua wa maskani. Kwa upande wa Negebu, kusini, [kutakuwa na] mapazia ya ua [ya] kitani safi iliyosokotwa, dhiraa mia moja urefu kwa upande mmoja.
sw.B: Ufanye pia ua wa maskani. Upande wa kusini ua uwe na mapazia ya kitani safi iliyosokotwa, yenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 45|dhiraa mia moja}} kwa upande huo.
sw.R: Tengeneza ua kuzunguka maskani. Upande wa kusini, tundika mapazia ya kitani safi iliyosokotwa. Upande huo uwe na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 45|dhiraa mia moja}}.

decisions.choice: hangings: lengths of cloth hung from pillars to make the courtyard wall
decisions.reason: The word is not the one used for the curtains of the tabernacle itself (26:1-13). These hangings, 5 cubits high (verse 18), formed an open-air enclosure around the tabernacle.

decisions.choice: the south side, southward: the side facing south
decisions.reason: Two words for south stand together for emphasis; the first is the name of the dry land to the south of Canaan. Each side of the courtyard is named by the direction it faces (verses 11-13).

decisions.choice: fine twisted linen: linen of fine thread, spun from several strands
decisions.reason: As in 26:1, the linen is fine, white cloth woven from thread made of strands twisted together for strength.

decisions.choice: modern measure first, cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the length of the side in feet by default, with the cubits of the Hebrew as the units alternative (a cubit is about 18 inches; see the note at verse 1). Literal keeps cubits.

decisions.choice: around the tabernacle
decisions.reason: Readable says where the courtyard is; its walls went around the tabernacle on all four sides (verses 9-13).

decisions.choice: "el atrio"; "colgaduras" (qela'im)
decisions.reason: "Atrio" is the usual word for an enclosed court before a sanctuary. The courtyard hangings are a different Hebrew word from the curtains of the tabernacle (26:1), so they are "colgaduras", not "cortinas".

decisions.choice: "le parvis" (L, B), "une cour" (R); "toiles" (qela'im)
decisions.reason: "Parvis" is the usual word for the court before a sanctuary; Readable says "cour", the everyday word. The hangings are a different Hebrew word from the curtains of the tabernacle ("tentures", 26:1), so they are "toiles", lengths of linen cloth.

decisions.choice: "ua"; "mapazia ya ua" (qela'im)
decisions.reason: "Ua" is an enclosed yard. Swahili has no separate word for the courtyard hangings, so Literal and Balanced say "mapazia ya ua" where the context needs it, to keep them apart from the curtains of the tabernacle itself (26:1).

source.text: וְעַמֻּדָ֣יו עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃

records.literal_gloss: And its pillars twenty and their bases twenty [of] bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands [of] silver.

en.L: And its pillars [shall be] twenty and their bases twenty, [of] bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands [shall be of] silver.
en.B: Its twenty pillars are to stand in twenty bronze bases, and the hooks and bands on the pillars are to be silver.
en.R: Hang the hangings on twenty posts that stand in twenty bronze bases. Put silver hooks and silver bands on the posts.

es.L: Y sus columnas [serán] veinte y sus basas veinte, [de] bronce; los ganchos de las columnas y sus bandas [serán de] plata.
es.B: Sus veinte columnas estarán sobre veinte basas de bronce, y los ganchos y las bandas de las columnas serán de plata.
es.R: Cuelga las colgaduras de veinte postes que se apoyan en veinte basas de bronce. Pon en los postes ganchos de plata y bandas de plata.

fr.L: Et ses colonnes [seront] vingt et leurs socles vingt, [de] bronze ; les crochets des colonnes et leurs cercles [seront d’]argent.
fr.B: Ses vingt colonnes reposeront sur vingt socles de bronze, et les crochets et les cercles des colonnes seront en argent.
fr.R: Accroche les toiles à vingt poteaux posés sur vingt socles en bronze. Mets aux poteaux des crochets et des cercles en argent.

sw.L: Na nguzo zake [zitakuwa] ishirini na misingi yake ishirini, [ya] shaba; kulabu za nguzo na mikanda yake [itakuwa ya] fedha.
sw.B: Nguzo zake ishirini zisimame juu ya misingi ishirini ya shaba, na kulabu na mikanda ya nguzo hizo iwe ya fedha.
sw.R: Tundika mapazia hayo kwenye nguzo ishirini zilizosimama juu ya misingi ishirini ya shaba. Weka kulabu za fedha na mikanda ya fedha kwenye nguzo hizo.

decisions.choice: bases: heavy sockets or stands into which the pillars were set
decisions.reason: The same word is used for the silver bases of the tabernacle frames (26:19). Here, in the courtyard, they are bronze.

decisions.choice: hooks ... bands: hooks for hanging the hangings, and bands of silver around or between the pillars
decisions.reason: The hooks held the hangings (26:32). The word for "bands" is less certain: it may mean rings around the tops of the pillars, or rods running from pillar to pillar. The related verb in verse 17 says the pillars were "banded" with silver (38:17, 28).

decisions.choice: posts
decisions.reason: Readable says "posts" for the pillars of the courtyard, which held up cloth walls rather than a roof. Literal and Balanced keep "pillars".

decisions.choice: "bandas" (ḥashuqim)
decisions.reason: The note leaves open whether these were bands around the pillars or rods between them; "bandas" follows the English "bands" without deciding.

decisions.choice: "cercles" (ḥashuqim)
decisions.reason: The note leaves open whether these were bands around the pillars or rods between them; "cercles" takes the first sense, as the English "bands" leans, and "tringles" would be the rods.

decisions.choice: "mikanda" (ḥashuqim)
decisions.reason: The note leaves open whether these were bands around the pillars or rods between them; "mikanda" (bands) follows the English without deciding.

source.text: וְכֵ֨ן לִפְאַ֤ת צָפוֹן֙ בָּאֹ֔רֶךְ קְלָעִ֖ים מֵ֣אָה אֹ֑רֶךְ וְעַמּוּדָ֣יו עֶשְׂרִ֗ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֤ם עֶשְׂרִים֙ נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָֽעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃

records.literal_gloss: And so for the side of the north in length, hangings one hundred [cubits] length, and its pillars twenty and their bases twenty [of] bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands [of] silver.

en.L: And likewise for the north side, in length, hangings 100 [cubits] long, and its pillars twenty and their bases twenty, [of] bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands [of] silver.
en.B: The north side is to be the same: hangings {{units:about 150 feet|100 cubits}} long, with twenty pillars in twenty bronze bases, and silver hooks and bands on the pillars.
en.R: Do the same on the north side. Put up hangings {{units:about 150 feet|100 cubits}} long on twenty posts that stand in twenty bronze bases. Put silver hooks and bands on the posts.

es.L: Y así para el lado norte, a lo largo, colgaduras de cien [codos de] largo, y sus columnas veinte y sus basas veinte, [de] bronce; los ganchos de las columnas y sus bandas [de] plata.
es.B: Lo mismo en el lado norte: colgaduras de {{units:unos 45 metros|cien codos}} de largo, con veinte columnas sobre veinte basas de bronce, y ganchos y bandas de plata en las columnas.
es.R: Haz lo mismo en el lado norte. Pon colgaduras de {{units:unos 45 metros|cien codos}} de largo en veinte postes que se apoyan en veinte basas de bronce. Pon en los postes ganchos y bandas de plata.

fr.L: Et de même pour le côté nord, en longueur, des toiles de cent [coudées de] long, et ses colonnes vingt et leurs socles vingt, [de] bronze ; les crochets des colonnes et leurs cercles [d’]argent.
fr.B: Il en sera de même du côté nord : des toiles de {{units:environ 45 mètres|cent coudées}} de long, avec vingt colonnes sur vingt socles de bronze, et des crochets et des cercles d’argent aux colonnes.
fr.R: Fais de même du côté nord. Dresse des toiles de {{units:environ 45 mètres|cent coudées}} de long sur vingt poteaux posés sur vingt socles en bronze. Mets aux poteaux des crochets et des cercles en argent.

sw.L: Na vivyo hivyo kwa upande wa kaskazini, kwa urefu, mapazia [ya dhiraa] mia moja urefu, na nguzo zake ishirini na misingi yake ishirini, [ya] shaba; kulabu za nguzo na mikanda yake [ya] fedha.
sw.B: Upande wa kaskazini uwe vivyo hivyo: mapazia yenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 45|dhiraa mia moja}}, pamoja na nguzo ishirini juu ya misingi ishirini ya shaba, na kulabu na mikanda ya fedha kwenye nguzo.
sw.R: Fanya vivyo hivyo upande wa kaskazini. Tundika mapazia yenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 45|dhiraa mia moja}} kwenye nguzo ishirini zilizosimama juu ya misingi ishirini ya shaba. Weka kulabu na mikanda ya fedha kwenye nguzo hizo.

decisions.choice: likewise ... one hundred: the north side matches the south side
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "one hundred"; the unit, cubits, is carried over from verse 9. The long north and south sides are the same in every detail.

decisions.choice: modern measure first, cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the length of the side in feet by default, with the cubits of the Hebrew as the units alternative (a cubit is about 18 inches; see the note at verse 1). Literal keeps cubits.

source.text: וְרֹ֤חַב הֶֽחָצֵר֙ לִפְאַת־יָ֔ם קְלָעִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם עֲשָׂרָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the breadth of the courtyard for the side of [the] west, hangings [of] fifty cubits; their pillars ten and their bases ten.

en.L: And the breadth of the courtyard on the west side [shall be] hangings of 50 cubits; their pillars ten and their bases ten.
en.B: Across the width of the courtyard, on the west side, there are to be hangings {{units:about 75 feet|50 cubits}} long, with ten pillars and ten bases.
en.R: The west end of the courtyard is to be {{units:about 75 feet|50 cubits}} wide. Put up hangings there on ten posts that stand in ten bases.

es.L: Y la anchura del atrio del lado del occidente [será de] colgaduras de cincuenta codos; sus columnas diez y sus basas diez.
es.B: A lo ancho del atrio, en el lado occidental, habrá colgaduras de {{units:unos 22,50 metros|cincuenta codos}} de largo, con diez columnas y diez basas.
es.R: El lado oeste del atrio debe medir {{units:unos 22,50 metros|cincuenta codos}} de ancho. Pon allí colgaduras en diez postes que se apoyan en diez basas.

fr.L: Et la largeur du parvis du côté de l’occident [sera de] toiles de cinquante coudées ; leurs colonnes dix et leurs socles dix.
fr.B: Sur la largeur du parvis, du côté ouest, il y aura des toiles de {{units:environ 22,50 mètres|cinquante coudées}} de long, avec dix colonnes et dix socles.
fr.R: Le côté ouest de la cour doit mesurer {{units:environ 22,50 mètres|cinquante coudées}} de large. Dresse là des toiles sur dix poteaux posés sur dix socles.

sw.L: Na upana wa ua upande wa magharibi [utakuwa] mapazia ya dhiraa hamsini; nguzo zake kumi na misingi yake kumi.
sw.B: Kwa upana wa ua, upande wa magharibi, kuwe na mapazia yenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 22.5|dhiraa hamsini}}, pamoja na nguzo kumi na misingi kumi.
sw.R: Upande wa magharibi wa ua uwe na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 22.5|dhiraa hamsini}}. Tundika mapazia hapo kwenye nguzo kumi zilizosimama juu ya misingi kumi.

decisions.choice: the west side: literally, the side of the sea
decisions.reason: In the land of Israel the Mediterranean Sea lies to the west, so "sea" is a common word for west (26:22, 27).

decisions.choice: the breadth: the short ends of the courtyard
decisions.reason: The courtyard was 100 cubits long from east to west and 50 cubits wide (verse 18). The west end lay behind the tabernacle (26:22).

decisions.choice: modern measure first, cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the width of the courtyard in feet by default, with the cubits of the Hebrew as the units alternative (a cubit is about 18 inches; see the note at verse 1). Literal keeps cubits.

source.text: וְרֹ֣חַב הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר לִפְאַ֛ת קֵ֥דְמָה מִזְרָ֖חָה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the breadth of the courtyard for the side of eastward, toward the sunrise, fifty cubits.

en.L: And the breadth of the courtyard on the east side, toward the sunrise, [shall be] 50 cubits.
en.B: The width of the courtyard on the east side, toward the sunrise, is also to be {{units:about 75 feet|50 cubits}}.
en.R: The east end, facing the sunrise, is also to be {{units:about 75 feet|50 cubits}} wide.

es.L: Y la anchura del atrio del lado oriental, hacia la salida del sol, [será de] cincuenta codos.
es.B: En el lado oriental, hacia donde sale el sol, la anchura del atrio será también de {{units:unos 22,50 metros|cincuenta codos}}.
es.R: El lado este, el que da a la salida del sol, también debe medir {{units:unos 22,50 metros|cincuenta codos}} de ancho.

fr.L: Et la largeur du parvis du côté de l’orient, vers le lever du soleil, [sera de] cinquante coudées.
fr.B: Du côté est, vers le lever du soleil, la largeur du parvis sera aussi de {{units:environ 22,50 mètres|cinquante coudées}}.
fr.R: Le côté est, face au lever du soleil, doit aussi mesurer {{units:environ 22,50 mètres|cinquante coudées}} de large.

sw.L: Na upana wa ua upande wa mashariki, kuelekea mawio ya jua, [utakuwa] dhiraa hamsini.
sw.B: Upana wa ua upande wa mashariki, kuelekea mawio ya jua, nao uwe {{units:karibu mita 22.5|dhiraa hamsini}}.
sw.R: Upande wa mashariki, unaoelekea jua linapochomoza, nao uwe na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 22.5|dhiraa hamsini}}.

decisions.choice: the east side, toward the sunrise: the front of the courtyard
decisions.reason: Two words for east stand together, the second meaning "the place of sunrise". The courtyard and the tabernacle faced east, and the gate was on this side (verses 14-16).

decisions.choice: modern measure first, cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the width of the courtyard in feet by default, with the cubits of the Hebrew as the units alternative (a cubit is about 18 inches; see the note at verse 1). Literal keeps cubits.

source.text: וַחֲמֵ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֛ה קְלָעִ֖ים לַכָּתֵ֑ף עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And fifteen cubits [of] hangings for the side; their pillars three and their bases three.

en.L: And 15 cubits [of] hangings for the [one] side; their pillars three and their bases three.
en.B: On one side of the entrance there are to be hangings {{units:about 22 1/2 feet|15 cubits}} long, with three pillars and three bases.
en.R: On one side of the gate, put up hangings {{units:about 22 1/2 feet|15 cubits}} long on three posts that stand in three bases.

es.L: Y quince codos [de] colgaduras para el [un] lado; sus columnas tres y sus basas tres.
es.B: A un lado de la entrada habrá colgaduras de {{units:unos 6,75 metros|quince codos}} de largo, con tres columnas y tres basas.
es.R: A un lado de la puerta, pon colgaduras de {{units:unos 6,75 metros|quince codos}} de largo en tres postes que se apoyan en tres basas.

fr.L: Et quinze coudées [de] toiles pour le [premier] côté ; leurs colonnes trois et leurs socles trois.
fr.B: D’un côté de l’entrée, il y aura des toiles de {{units:environ 6,75 mètres|quinze coudées}} de long, avec trois colonnes et trois socles.
fr.R: D’un côté de la porte, dresse des toiles de {{units:environ 6,75 mètres|quinze coudées}} de long sur trois poteaux posés sur trois socles.

sw.L: Na dhiraa kumi na tano [za] mapazia kwa upande [mmoja]; nguzo zake tatu na misingi yake mitatu.
sw.B: Upande mmoja wa mlango kuwe na mapazia yenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 6.75|dhiraa kumi na tano}}, pamoja na nguzo tatu na misingi mitatu.
sw.R: Upande mmoja wa lango, tundika mapazia yenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 6.75|dhiraa kumi na tano}} kwenye nguzo tatu zilizosimama juu ya misingi mitatu.

decisions.choice: side: literally "shoulder", the part of the east wall on either side of the gate
decisions.reason: The east end, 50 cubits wide, had 15 cubits of hangings on each side and a gateway 20 cubits wide in the middle (verses 13-16).

decisions.choice: modern measure first, cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the length of the hangings in feet by default, with the cubits of the Hebrew as the units alternative (a cubit is about 18 inches; see the note at verse 1). Literal keeps cubits.

decisions.choice: of the entrance / of the gate
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say which side is meant: one side of the gateway in the east wall.

source.text: וְלַכָּתֵף֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔ית חְמֵ֥שׁעֶשְׂרֵ֖ה קְלָעִ֑ים עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And for the second side fifteen [cubits of] hangings; their pillars three and their bases three.

en.L: And for the second side, 15 [cubits of] hangings; their pillars three and their bases three.
en.B: On the other side there are to be hangings {{units:about 22 1/2 feet|15 cubits}} long, with three pillars and three bases.
en.R: Do the same on the other side of the gate: hangings {{units:about 22 1/2 feet|15 cubits}} long on three posts that stand in three bases.

es.L: Y para el segundo lado, quince [codos de] colgaduras; sus columnas tres y sus basas tres.
es.B: Al otro lado habrá colgaduras de {{units:unos 6,75 metros|quince codos}} de largo, con tres columnas y tres basas.
es.R: Haz lo mismo al otro lado de la puerta: colgaduras de {{units:unos 6,75 metros|quince codos}} de largo en tres postes que se apoyan en tres basas.

fr.L: Et pour le second côté, quinze [coudées de] toiles ; leurs colonnes trois et leurs socles trois.
fr.B: De l’autre côté, il y aura des toiles de {{units:environ 6,75 mètres|quinze coudées}} de long, avec trois colonnes et trois socles.
fr.R: Fais de même de l’autre côté de la porte : des toiles de {{units:environ 6,75 mètres|quinze coudées}} de long sur trois poteaux posés sur trois socles.

sw.L: Na kwa upande wa pili, [dhiraa] kumi na tano [za] mapazia; nguzo zake tatu na misingi yake mitatu.
sw.B: Upande mwingine kuwe na mapazia yenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 6.75|dhiraa kumi na tano}}, pamoja na nguzo tatu na misingi mitatu.
sw.R: Fanya vivyo hivyo upande mwingine wa lango: mapazia yenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 6.75|dhiraa kumi na tano}} kwenye nguzo tatu zilizosimama juu ya misingi mitatu.

decisions.choice: the second side: the other side of the gate
decisions.reason: The two sides of 15 cubits each and the gate of 20 cubits make up the 50 cubits of the east end (verse 13). "Cubits" is carried over from verse 14.

decisions.choice: modern measure first, cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the length of the hangings in feet by default, with the cubits of the Hebrew as the units alternative (a cubit is about 18 inches; see the note at verse 1). Literal keeps cubits.

source.text: וּלְשַׁ֨עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֜ר מָסָ֣ךְ׀עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן וְתוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם עַמֻּֽדֵיהֶם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם אַרְבָּעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And for the gate of the courtyard a screen [of] twenty cubits, [of] violet and purple and scarlet of crimson and fine linen twisted, [the] work of an embroiderer; their pillars four and their bases four.

en.L: And for the gate of the courtyard [there shall be] a screen of 20 cubits, [of] blue and purple and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer; their pillars four and their bases four.
en.B: The gateway of the courtyard is to have a screen {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}} wide, of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, worked by an embroiderer, and hung on four pillars set in four bases.
en.R: For the gate of the courtyard, make a screen {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}} wide. Have a skilled worker make it in colorful patterns, using blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen. Hang it on four posts that stand in four bases.

es.L: Y para la puerta del atrio [habrá] una cortina de veinte codos, [de hilo] azul, y púrpura, y escarlata, y lino fino torcido, obra de bordador; sus columnas cuatro y sus basas cuatro.
es.B: La puerta del atrio tendrá una cortina de {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho, de hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata y de lino fino torcido, obra de bordador, colgada de cuatro columnas sobre cuatro basas.
es.R: Para la puerta del atrio, haz una cortina de {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho. Pide a un trabajador hábil que la haga con dibujos de colores, usando hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata y lino fino torcido. Cuélgala de cuatro postes que se apoyan en cuatro basas.

fr.L: Et pour la porte du parvis, [il y aura] un rideau de vingt coudées, [de fil] bleu, et pourpre, et écarlate, et de fin lin retors, ouvrage de brodeur ; leurs colonnes quatre et leurs socles quatre.
fr.B: La porte du parvis aura un rideau de {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large, de fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate et de fin lin retors, travaillé par un brodeur et suspendu à quatre colonnes posées sur quatre socles.
fr.R: Pour la porte de la cour, fais un rideau de {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large. Demande à un ouvrier habile de le faire avec des motifs de couleurs, en fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate et en fin lin retors. Suspends-le à quatre poteaux posés sur quatre socles.

sw.L: Na kwa lango la ua [kutakuwa na] pazia la dhiraa ishirini, [la uzi wa] samawati, na zambarau, na rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa, kazi ya mtarizi; nguzo zake nne na misingi yake minne.
sw.B: Lango la ua liwe na pazia lenye upana wa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}, la uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa, kazi ya mtarizi, lililotundikwa kwenye nguzo nne juu ya misingi minne.
sw.R: Kwa ajili ya lango la ua, tengeneza pazia lenye upana wa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}. Mwambie fundi stadi alitengeneze kwa michoro ya rangi, akitumia uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa. Litundike kwenye nguzo nne zilizosimama juu ya misingi minne.

decisions.choice: a screen: the hanging that closed the entrance
decisions.reason: The same word is used for the screen at the door of the tabernacle (26:36-37). Unlike the white linen walls, the gate's screen was made in colors, like the tabernacle's own curtains.

decisions.choice: blue and purple and scarlet: yarn dyed in costly colors
decisions.reason: As in 25:4 and 26:1, these are wool yarns dyed blue (a blue-violet), purple and scarlet, colors that were costly to make.

decisions.choice: the work of an embroiderer: work in colored thread
alternatives: the work of a weaver in colors
decisions.reason: The word describes a worker in colors. Whether the designs were sewn on with a needle or woven into the cloth is not certain (26:36; 35:35).

decisions.choice: modern measure first, cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the width of the gate in feet by default, with the cubits of the Hebrew as the units alternative (a cubit is about 18 inches; see the note at verse 1). Literal keeps cubits.

decisions.choice: a skilled worker ... in colorful patterns
decisions.reason: Readable describes the work without deciding between needlework and weaving.

source.text: כָּל־עַמּוּדֵ֨י הֶֽחָצֵ֤ר סָבִיב֙ מְחֻשָּׁקִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף וָוֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: All the pillars of the courtyard all around [will be] banded [with] silver; their hooks [of] silver and their bases [of] bronze.

en.L: All the pillars of the courtyard all around [shall be] banded [with] silver; their hooks [of] silver and their bases [of] bronze.
en.B: Every pillar around the courtyard is to be fitted with silver bands; their hooks are to be silver and their bases bronze.
en.R: All the way around the courtyard, each post is to have bands and hooks of silver and a base of bronze.

es.L: Todas las columnas del atrio alrededor [estarán] provistas de bandas [de] plata; sus ganchos [de] plata y sus basas [de] bronce.
es.B: Todas las columnas alrededor del atrio tendrán bandas de plata; sus ganchos serán de plata y sus basas de bronce.
es.R: Todo alrededor del atrio, cada poste debe tener bandas y ganchos de plata y una basa de bronce.

fr.L: Toutes les colonnes du parvis, tout autour, [seront] cerclées [d’]argent ; leurs crochets [d’]argent et leurs socles [de] bronze.
fr.B: Toutes les colonnes autour du parvis seront garnies de cercles d’argent ; leurs crochets seront en argent et leurs socles en bronze.
fr.R: Tout autour de la cour, chaque poteau doit avoir des cercles et des crochets en argent, et un socle en bronze.

sw.L: Nguzo zote za ua kuzunguka pande zote [zitakuwa] zimefungwa mikanda [ya] fedha; kulabu zake [za] fedha na misingi yake [ya] shaba.
sw.B: Kila nguzo kuzunguka ua iwekewe mikanda ya fedha; kulabu zake ziwe za fedha na misingi yake ya shaba.
sw.R: Kuzunguka ua wote, kila nguzo lazima iwe na mikanda na kulabu za fedha, na msingi wa shaba.

decisions.choice: banded with silver: fitted with silver bands
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the same root as "bands" in verse 10. Whether the bands ringed each pillar or joined the pillars together is not certain (see the note at verse 10; 38:17).

decisions.choice: all around: on all four sides
decisions.reason: The rule covers every pillar of the courtyard, on the long sides, the west end and the east end with its gate.

source.text: אֹ֣רֶךְ הֶֽחָצֵר֩ מֵאָ֨ה בָֽאַמָּ֜ה וְרֹ֣חַב׀חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֗ים וְקֹמָ֛ה חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: The length of the courtyard one hundred by the cubit, and the breadth fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, [of] fine linen twisted, and their bases [of] bronze.

en.L: The length of the courtyard [shall be] 100 cubits, and the breadth 50 by 50, and the height 5 cubits, [of] fine twisted linen, and their bases [of] bronze.
en.B: In all, the courtyard measures {{units:about 150 feet|100 cubits}} in length and {{units:about 75 feet|50 cubits}} across at each end. Its walls of fine twisted linen stand {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} high, and the bases are bronze.
en.R: So the whole courtyard will be {{units:about 150 feet|100 cubits}} long and {{units:about 75 feet|50 cubits}} wide. Its linen walls will be {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} high, standing in bronze bases.

es.L: La longitud del atrio [será] cien codos, y la anchura cincuenta por cincuenta, y la altura cinco codos, [de] lino fino torcido, y sus basas [de] bronce.
es.B: En total, el atrio medirá {{units:unos 45 metros|cien codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 22,50 metros|cincuenta codos}} de ancho en cada extremo. Sus paredes de lino fino torcido tendrán {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de alto, y las basas serán de bronce.
es.R: Así, todo el atrio medirá {{units:unos 45 metros|cien codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 22,50 metros|cincuenta codos}} de ancho. Sus paredes de lino tendrán {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de alto y se apoyarán en basas de bronce.

fr.L: La longueur du parvis [sera de] cent coudées, et la largeur cinquante sur cinquante, et la hauteur cinq coudées, [en] fin lin retors, et leurs socles [de] bronze.
fr.B: En tout, le parvis mesurera {{units:environ 45 mètres|cent coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 22,50 mètres|cinquante coudées}} de large à chaque extrémité. Ses murs de fin lin retors auront {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de haut, et les socles seront en bronze.
fr.R: La cour entière mesurera donc {{units:environ 45 mètres|cent coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 22,50 mètres|cinquante coudées}} de large. Ses murs de lin auront {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de haut et reposeront sur des socles en bronze.

sw.L: Urefu wa ua [utakuwa] dhiraa mia moja, na upana hamsini kwa hamsini, na kimo dhiraa tano, [za] kitani safi iliyosokotwa, na misingi yake [ya] shaba.
sw.B: Kwa jumla, ua utakuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 45|dhiraa mia moja}} na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 22.5|dhiraa hamsini}} kila mwisho. Kuta zake za kitani safi iliyosokotwa ziwe na kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}, na misingi iwe ya shaba.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo ua wote utakuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 45|dhiraa mia moja}} na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 22.5|dhiraa hamsini}}. Kuta zake za kitani zitakuwa na kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}, zikisimama juu ya misingi ya shaba.

decisions.choice: 50 by 50: 50 cubits at each end
decisions.reason: The phrase most likely means that the width was 50 cubits at both the west end and the east end (verses 12-13).

decisions.choice: the height 5 cubits: the height of the hangings
decisions.reason: The linen walls were 5 cubits high, half the height of the frames of the tabernacle, which were 10 cubits (26:16).

decisions.choice: modern measure first, cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the size of the courtyard in feet by default, with the cubits of the Hebrew as the units alternative (a cubit is about 18 inches; see the note at verse 1). Literal keeps cubits.

decisions.choice: walls of fine twisted linen / linen walls
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "fine twisted linen", meaning the hangings. Balanced and Readable call them walls, which is what they formed.

source.text: לְכֹל֙ כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן בְּכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָת֑וֹ וְכָל־יְתֵדֹתָ֛יו וְכָל־יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶחָצֵ֖ר נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For all the articles of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its tent pegs and all the pegs of the courtyard, [of] bronze.

en.L: All the utensils of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its tent pegs, and all the tent pegs of the courtyard, [shall be of] bronze.
en.B: All the tools used for every task in the tabernacle, and all its tent pegs and those of the courtyard, are to be made of bronze.
en.R: All the tools used for the work of the tabernacle must be made of bronze. So must all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard.

es.L: Todos los utensilios del tabernáculo en todo su servicio, y todas sus estacas, y todas las estacas del atrio, [serán de] bronce.
es.B: Todas las herramientas que se usen en cualquier tarea del tabernáculo, y todas sus estacas y las del atrio, serán de bronce.
es.R: Todas las herramientas que se usen para el trabajo del tabernáculo deben ser de bronce. Lo mismo todas las estacas del tabernáculo y del atrio.

fr.L: Tous les ustensiles de la Demeure pour tout son service, et tous ses piquets, et tous les piquets du parvis, [seront de] bronze.
fr.B: Tous les outils servant aux diverses tâches de la Demeure, ainsi que tous ses piquets et ceux du parvis, seront en bronze.
fr.R: Tous les outils utilisés pour le travail du tabernacle doivent être en bronze. Il en va de même pour tous les piquets du tabernacle et de la cour.

sw.L: Vyombo vyote vya maskani katika huduma yake yote, na vigingi vyake vyote, na vigingi vyote vya ua, [vitakuwa vya] shaba.
sw.B: Vifaa vyote vinavyotumika kwa kila kazi ya maskani, pamoja na vigingi vyake vyote na vile vya ua, viwe vya shaba.
sw.R: Vifaa vyote vinavyotumika kwa kazi ya maskani lazima viwe vya shaba. Vivyo hivyo vigingi vyote vya maskani na vya ua.

decisions.choice: the utensils of the tabernacle in all its service: the tools for setting up and working in the tabernacle
decisions.reason: These are not the gold furnishings inside the tabernacle (25:11-39) but the tools used to set it up, take it down and serve in it, which were bronze like the courtyard.

decisions.choice: tent pegs: pegs driven into the ground to hold the cords
decisions.reason: The pegs held down the cords of the tabernacle and of the courtyard hangings (35:18; 38:20, 31).

source.text: וְאַתָּ֞ה תְּצַוֶּ֣ה׀אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר לְהַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, you will command the sons of Israel, and they will bring to you oil of olive, pure, beaten, for the light, to cause to go up a lamp continually.

en.L: And you, you shall command the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel that they bring to you pure olive oil, beaten, for the light, to make a lamp burn continually.
en.B: You are to give the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} this command: they must bring you pure beaten olive oil for the light, to make a lamp burn continually.
en.R: Tell the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} to bring you pure olive oil, made from crushed olives, for the light. That way a lamp can be kept burning all the time.

es.L: Y tú, mandarás a los hijos de Israel que te traigan aceite de oliva puro, machacado, para la luz, para hacer arder una lámpara continuamente.
es.B: Darás esta orden a los israelitas: que te traigan aceite puro de olivas machacadas para la luz, a fin de que una lámpara arda continuamente.
es.R: Diles a los israelitas que te traigan aceite de oliva puro, hecho con olivas trituradas, para la luz. Así se podrá mantener una lámpara encendida todo el tiempo.

fr.L: Et toi, tu ordonneras aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël qu’ils t’apportent de l’huile d’olive pure, broyée, pour la lumière, pour faire brûler une lampe continuellement.
fr.B: Tu donneras cet ordre aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} : qu’ils t’apportent de l’huile pure d’olives broyées pour la lumière, afin qu’une lampe brûle sans cesse.
fr.R: Dis aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} de t’apporter de l’huile d’olive pure, faite avec des olives écrasées, pour la lumière. Ainsi, une lampe pourra brûler tout le temps.

sw.L: Nawe utawaamuru wana wa Israeli wakuletee mafuta safi ya zeituni, yaliyopondwa, kwa ajili ya nuru, ili kuifanya taa iwake daima.
sw.B: Uwape Waisraeli agizo hili: wakuletee mafuta safi ya zeituni yaliyopondwa kwa ajili ya nuru, ili taa iwake daima.
sw.R: Waambie Waisraeli wakuletee mafuta safi ya zeituni, yaliyotengenezwa kwa zeituni zilizopondwa, kwa ajili ya nuru. Hivyo taa itaweza kuwaka wakati wote.

decisions.choice: pure beaten olive oil: the finest oil, from olives crushed by hand
decisions.reason: Beaten oil came from olives crushed in a mortar rather than pressed, which gave the clearest oil, used here for the lamp and in the daily offering (29:40; 1 Kings 5:11). The same command is repeated in Leviticus 24:2-4.

decisions.choice: to make a lamp burn: literally, to make a lamp go up
decisions.reason: The verb "to make go up" is used for lighting lamps (25:37; 30:8), perhaps because the flame rises. "Lamp" may stand for the lamps of the lampstand together (25:37).

decisions.choice: continually: regularly, every night
decisions.reason: The lamp was to burn through each night, "from evening to morning" (verse 21; 30:7-8; 1 Samuel 3:3), not without ever going out.

decisions.choice: made from crushed olives ... all the time
decisions.reason: Readable explains "beaten" and says "all the time" for "continually"; the note explains that this means every night.

source.text: בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֩ מִח֨וּץ לַפָּרֹ֜כֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָעֵדֻ֗ת יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו מֵעֶ֥רֶב עַד־בֹּ֖קֶר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹ֣רֹתָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: In [the] tent of meeting, outside the curtain which [is] over the testimony, will arrange it Aaron and his sons from evening until morning before Yahweh; a statute of perpetuity for their generations from the sons of Israel.

en.L: In the tent of meeting, outside the veil which [is] over the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall arrange it from evening until morning before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; [it is] a statute forever throughout their generations from the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: Aaron and his sons are to tend it in the tent of meeting, outside the curtain that screens the testimony, from evening to morning before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. This is a statute for all time for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, generation after generation.
en.R: Aaron and his sons must take care of the lamp in the tent of meeting, outside the curtain in front of the ark that held the covenant tablets. They must keep it burning before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from evening until morning. This is a rule the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} must keep for all time, in every generation.

es.L: En la Tienda del Encuentro, fuera del velo que [está] sobre el Testimonio, Aarón y sus hijos la dispondrán desde la tarde hasta la mañana delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; [es] un estatuto perpetuo por sus generaciones de parte de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Aarón y sus hijos la cuidarán en la Tienda del Encuentro, fuera de la cortina que resguarda el Testimonio, desde la tarde hasta la mañana, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Este es un estatuto perpetuo para los israelitas, de generación en generación.
es.R: Aarón y sus hijos deben cuidar la lámpara en la Tienda del Encuentro, fuera de la cortina que está delante del arca donde están las tablas del pacto. Deben mantenerla encendida delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} desde la tarde hasta la mañana. Esta es una norma que los israelitas deben cumplir para siempre, en cada generación.

fr.L: Dans la tente de la Rencontre, à l’extérieur du voile qui [est] sur le Témoignage, Aaron et ses fils la disposeront du soir jusqu’au matin devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; [c’est] une loi perpétuelle pour leurs générations, de la part des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Aaron et ses fils l’entretiendront dans la tente de la Rencontre, à l’extérieur du rideau qui abrite le Témoignage, du soir au matin, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. C’est une loi perpétuelle pour les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, de génération en génération.
fr.R: Aaron et ses fils doivent s’occuper de la lampe dans la tente de la Rencontre, à l’extérieur du rideau placé devant l’arche qui contient les tablettes de l’alliance. Ils doivent la faire brûler devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} du soir jusqu’au matin. C’est une règle que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} doivent respecter pour toujours, à chaque génération.

sw.L: Katika Hema la Kukutania, nje ya pazia lililo juu ya Ushuhuda, Haruni na wanawe wataipanga tangu jioni hadi asubuhi mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; [ni] kanuni ya kudumu milele katika vizazi vyao kutoka kwa wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Haruni na wanawe waitunze katika Hema la Kukutania, nje ya pazia linalofunika Ushuhuda, tangu jioni hadi asubuhi mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hii ni kanuni ya kudumu milele kwa Waisraeli, kizazi baada ya kizazi.
sw.R: Haruni na wanawe lazima waitunze taa katika Hema la Kukutania, nje ya pazia lililo mbele ya sanduku lenye vibao vya agano. Lazima waiwashe mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tangu jioni hadi asubuhi. Hili ni agizo ambalo Waisraeli lazima walishike milele, katika kila kizazi.

decisions.choice: the tent of meeting: the tent where God meets with his people
decisions.reason: This is the first use of the name in Exodus. God says he will meet with Moses and the Israelites there (29:42-43; 33:7). It is another name for the tabernacle.

decisions.choice: the veil over the testimony: the inner curtain in front of the ark
decisions.reason: The veil of 26:31-33 divided the holy place from the most holy place, where the ark held the testimony, the tablets of the covenant (25:16, 21). The lampstand stood outside it, in the holy place (26:35).

decisions.choice: a statute forever ... from the sons of Israel: a lasting duty laid on Israel
alternatives: to be supplied by the sons of Israel
decisions.reason: The tending of the lamp is a statute for all generations. "From the sons of Israel" may mean that the duty is required of Israel, or that the oil for it is to come from them (verse 20).

decisions.choice: tend / take care of
decisions.reason: The verb means to set in order; for a lamp, to trim it and fill it so it keeps burning. Literal keeps "arrange".

decisions.choice: curtain
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "curtain" for the inner veil, as in 26:31-35. Literal keeps "veil".

decisions.choice: the ark that held the covenant tablets ... a rule
decisions.reason: Readable names the ark that held the testimony, the covenant tablets, and says "rule" for "statute". Balanced says "statute for all time"; Literal "statute forever".
